thread:
Ashwin Desai: Quick check — PR #18902 blocked by mac-e2e flake. Suggest we hold the merge until we either get a green or opt for a canary-only rollout. Deployment blackout starts Sun 00:00 UTC. Thoughts?

Maria Chen: I see the same failure. It's timing out in `browser-launcher` on Safari. Re-running the single job now: `/ci retry job mac-e2e/18902`

release-bot: mac-e2e job rerun queued — job id ci-748291. ETA ~12m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/ci-748291

Tiago Oliveira: If rerun fails, +1 for canary-only. We can route ~10% traffic to the change to avoid a full rollout during the blackout. Someone will need to add the canary flag to the rollout manifest.

Ashwin Desai: Sounds good. Maria, if rerun fails and you can't get a quick fix, can you open a tiny PR that sets `feature.canary=true`? I can do a fast approval and merge.

Maria Chen: Will try to fix first. If it's still failing by 20:30 UTC I'll open the canary PR. @SRE Oncall — can you confirm rollback window for the blackout?

SRE Oncall: Noted. Rollback window during this blackout is Mon 06:00-09:00 UTC (scheduled maintenance). If you go canary, please attach metric hooks so we auto-roll back on a sustained 5% error increase. I'll add a temporary alert rule.

Tiago Oliveira: Also FYI: the rebase window closes Sat 22:00 UTC. If we rebase late we'll likely trigger extra CI runs and more flakiness. Prefer canary patch to avoid rebase churn.

Ashwin Desai: OK — I'll update the PR description with the canary plan and a note about avoiding rebases unless necessary. Will wait for rerun outcome.

release-bot: ci-748291 mac-e2e job finished — status: failed. Same `browser-launcher` timeout. See logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/ci-748291/logs

Maria Chen: Ugh. Opening canary PR now with `feature.canary=true` and a tiny smoke-test exclusion that doesn't affect prod paths. Link: https://github.com/redwood/pr/18905 — requesting fast-review.

Tiago Oliveira: Reviewing now :eyes:

Ashwin Desai: Approved from my side. Once the canary is green we'll merge and route limited traffic. I'll add a note in the ops doc for who to contact if we need to expedite rollback.

Maria Chen: Merged canary PR and kicked the canary deploy. cc @SRE Oncall

SRE Oncall: Canary is up. Monitoring metrics; will alert if error rate > 5% over 10m.

Ashwin Desai: Thanks everyone — closing the manual merge hold for mainline. We'll keep PR #18902 blocked from full merge until we pass a full e2e run on Monday morning.
